- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36746-36750 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_issueless_review_retry_decide` hardcodes a threshold of 2 for repeated failures by checking `$fails[-2]`, while the in-run logic uses `REVIEW_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_MAX_IDENTICAL_REVIEWERS_FAILED` (default 2, configurable).
  WHY: With a threshold other than 2, the poller and the in-run logic disagree: 3 or more makes the poller block too early, and 1 makes it fail to block. Source severity was MAJOR. This is related to the z-ai_glm-5_3-flash finding at lines 36757-36760, kept separate because the ranges are more than 5 lines apart. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it as a defect because the branch only relabels a `waiting_for_release` outcome and never dispatches.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36757-36760 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The poller's `repeated_reviewer_failure` rule hardcodes a threshold of two same-head, same-fp markers through `$fails[-2]`, while the in-run block in `scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh` honours `REVIEW_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_MAX_IDENTICAL_REVIEWERS_FAILED`.
  WHY: Any other configured value makes the reported reason diverge from the in-run block. The impact is bounded, because the rule only relabels an already-skipped `waiting_for_release` outcome and never changes a dispatch (header comment at lines 36712-36723). Source severity was NIT.
